title: Valid Parentheses
summary: Check that every bracket in a string is closed by the right kind of bracket, in the right order.

tests.explain: Each pair opens and closes immediately, one after another.
When ] arrives, the most recently opened bracket is (, not [. The brackets cross instead of nesting.
[] closes inside {}, and then {} closes: properly nested.

hints: The bracket that must close next is always the most recently opened one that is still open. Which data structure gives you the most recent item first?
Push every opening bracket. On a closing bracket, the top of the stack must be its partner: pop it, or return false if the stack is empty or holds the wrong kind.
A Map from each closing bracket to its opening partner keeps the check to one line. At the end, the string is valid only if the stack is empty.

complexity.time: O(n): each character is pushed and popped at most once
complexity.space: O(n): the stack can hold every character, as in "(((("
